m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>Your shoes really grip the path well now. </ITALICS>
Whhaat isss thisss ssspark I sssmell? A Wizzzard? Let me exxtinguisssh that fire for you!
I can't believe we bested that loathsome beast! Huzzah! You will always have the trust of the Fire Elves!
Now that the Winter Wyrm is gone, we can melt the hoarfrost curse with the Living Ember.
Please help me thaw out the village. We can look for Sir Robin while we do so.
<ITALICS>You release the Living Ember into the air and it swirls around, melting the snow and ice. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The trees burst into flame. A bit wild, but beautiful in their natural state. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The houses thaw and the Fire Elves warm up. And you even find a knight under a layer of frost. There is much rejoicing! </ITALICS>
A Winter Wyrm you say? Well, that doesn't sound too scary. Let me just find a woolly sweater... wait, who are you?
Now we can travel down the icy path to the Winter Wyrm's lair, and drive him out!
He's a terrible beast of winter and storm and we will need every ounce of courage to win. And by "we," I mean you.
Go down the icy path, enter the Frozen Cave, and vanquish the Winter Wyrm! May the Fire Spirits keep you toasty!
